description: This is a shell script for configuring network settings and reverse tethering between an Android device and a host system. It includes routines for starting/stopping RNDIS, setting up NAT, bridging, and managing routing configurations, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: rndis_start
methods.description: Starts the RNDIS USB function on the device and optionally sets hardware address.

methods.name: rndis_stop
methods.description: Stops the RNDIS USB function on the device.

methods.name: rndis_test
methods.description: Configures IP addresses on the device and host, then tests connectivity via ping.

methods.name: update_dns
methods.description: Increments the DNS change property on the device to trigger DNS update.

methods.name: default_routes
methods.description: Retrieves default route interfaces from the device.

methods.name: route_none
methods.description: Disables data and wifi services on the device, removes default routes.

methods.name: route_nat
methods.description: Configures the device and host for NAT routing.

methods.name: route_bridge
methods.description: Configures the device for DHCP, sets DNS, for bridging setup.

methods.name: route_reset
methods.description: Resets routing on the device, re-enabling data service.

methods.name: nat_start
methods.description: Enables IP forwarding and sets up iptables for NAT.

methods.name: nat_secure
methods.description: Sets firewall rules for a more secure NAT setup.

methods.name: nat_stop
methods.description: Disables IP forwarding and clears iptables NAT rules.

methods.name: bridge_start
methods.description: Creates and sets up a network bridge, attaches LAN interface.

methods.name: bridge_add
methods.description: Adds the USB network interface to the existing bridge.

methods.name: bridge_stop
methods.description: Tears down the bridge and resets network interfaces.

calls: sudo iptables -A FORWARD -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
sudo iptables -A FORWARD -m state --state NEW -i $HOST_DEV -j ACCEPT
